about_the_game:
Deep World is a 2D stealth adventure game set in an alien underwater realm. Guide a fragile little creature as it explores, hides, and outmaneuver procedural animated monstrous predators on it quest to rescue a lost friend. Can you navigate the depths and make it back home alive?

Features:

  • Dynamic Underwater World

Explore a mysterious, alien ocean teeming with life and danger, brought to life with stunning 2D art and procedural animations.

  • Immersive Stealth Gameplay

Outsmart procedural animated predators by sneaking, hiding, and using your wits to survive.

  • A cinematic emotional journey

Embark on a heartfelt adventure to reunite with your lost companion and find your way back home.

About the development

Deep World was originally created as project in a game design graduate class at USC Games, in collaboration with students from Berklee School of Music. Later finished and polished for this full release by Jose Striedinger.

short_description: Guide a little green creature as it goes deep into a dark, dangerous underwater world once sealed off. You'll need to explore, hide, and outmaneuver different predators to find your lost friend and make it back home in one piece. Whatever you do, avoid the nests!
